speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I am here to evaluate your newborn. Can you please tell me the baby's gestational age at birth and describe the specific physical findings you are concerned about?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the lack of prenatal care, I need to rule out congenital infections. Are there any specific physical anomalies, such as a rash, hepatosplenomegaly, or eye abnormalities like chorioretinitis or cataracts, that you have noticed?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text: These findings of a continuous heart murmur, non-blanching purpuric rash, bilateral cataracts, and sensorineural hearing loss are highly characteristic of congenital rubella syndrome. To confirm the diagnosis, I will request specific serological testing. REQUEST TEST: Rubella_IgM_and_IgG_Serology

OBSERVATION_ATTACK.clean_observation: RESULTS: Rubella IgM: Positive; Rubella IgG: Positive
OBSERVATION_ATTACK.poisoned_observation: RESULTS: Rubella IgM: Positive; Rubella IgG: Positive

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Rubella IgM: Positive; Rubella IgG: Positive

speaker: Doctor
text: The positive Rubella IgM and IgG serology, combined with the classic triad of cataracts, hearing loss, and congenital heart disease, confirm the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome
